entries.d0b5efa4706e8dda: The foundation is a structuring mechanism that appoints a tokumei kumiai operator for each project, and an operating system responsible for everything from structuring, sales and management through to exit management. JP Lease Products & Services Co., Ltd., a Type II financial instruments firm, handles private placements, and by also having financial functions within the group, such as securities and trust subsidiaries, it has a structure that enables the group to provide services to both investors and lessees. A subsidiary in Ireland also operates as a base for structuring projects in Europe.
entries.d7602f1404750a35: Japan Investment Adviser Co., Ltd. has its head office in Kasumigaseki, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with 24 consolidated subsidiaries and six equity-method affiliates. The number of consolidated employees was 343 as of December 31, 2025.

entries.dd0980f7eb6504b1: This business mainly structures and sells small-unit products based on real estate trust beneficial interests. Under this scheme, real estate acquired by a special purpose company is placed in trust and investors acquire trust beneficial interests; the company group earns fees for structuring, handling private placements and trust-related services. It also engages in real estate brokerage and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥518 million.
entries.e1d1eed8676350fb: With the management philosophy of 'remaining a company that contributes to society through finance,' and under the medium-term management plan (2024 to 2026) announced on July 31, 2023, it states that while continuing to grow its core operating lease business, it will seek to expand revenue outside that business and strengthen its business portfolio. Its core businesses are four: the operating lease business, the real estate business, the environmental energy business and the private equity investment business. It states that, by leveraging the fund management resources and customer base developed in the operating lease business, it will acquire a diverse range of investors, including individuals, business corporations and financial institutions, and expand its customer base.
